section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the building of Malchus on Rosh Hashanah is primarily connected to the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof, the aspect of "Zeh," and links this to the renewal of the inner worlds.
section.t: And one can say the explanation in this,
that this that on Rosh Hashanah is the building of Malchus,
this relates
(primarily)
to this that Rosh Hashanah is "this day,"
the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof,
the aspect of "Zeh."
[And one can connect this also with the explanation
(as is implied in many places)
that the connection of Rosh Hashanah to the building of Malchus is because on Rosh Hashanah is the renewal of the Seder Hishtalshelus.
For behold, it is known what is explained in the Siddur
(in Shaar HaTekios, beginning "L’havin Inyan Tekias Shofar al pi Kavanas HaBaal Shem Tov z"l88),
that this that on Rosh Hashanah the renewal of the entire order of Hishtalshelus takes place,
is
(primarily)
in the pnimiyus (innerness) of the worlds,
except that through this a renewal is also brought about in the chitzoniyus (externality) of the worlds,
so that it will not be in a manner of "refiyas yadayim" (weakness of hands).
And based on this, one can connect the two explanations regarding the connection of the building of Malchus to Rosh Hashanah
(that on Rosh Hashanah is the renewal of the Seder Hishtalshelus and that on Rosh Hashanah is the drawing down of the aspect of "Zeh"),
because the renewal in the pnimiyus of the worlds relates to the drawing down of the aspect of "Zeh"].
And this is that the emphasis on Rosh Hashanah is on the matter of the kingship within Malchus
(and not on the speech of Malchus),
because the matter of the building of Malchus
(the drawing down of Malchus from its source)
relates to the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof.
For although all the Sefiros, their drawing down is from the Essence of Ein Sof, as it is written89
"Ki Mimcha HaKol" (for from You is everything)
[and certainly the speech of Malchus,
the ten utterances with which the world was created from yesh (something) to ayin (nothing),
and as is known, creation yesh mei’ayin is through the power of the Essence,
for He alone, in His power and ability, can create yesh mei’ayin and absolute nothingness90],
nevertheless,
the matter of the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof
(the aspect of "Zeh"),
which is the matter of Rosh Hashanah as mentioned above,
relates primarily specifically to the building of Malchus.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section details the fundamental differences between the Sefirah of Malchus and all other Sefiros, tracing these distinctions back to Malchus's unique root in Reisha d’Lo Isyada.
section.t: And this will be understood based on what is explained in the discourses of our Nesi’im regarding the difference between the attribute of Malchus and the other attributes,
that one can say the point of these explanations is as stated by the Rebbe, my father-in-law, in the discourse "Shofar Shel Rosh Hashanah"91,
that the attribute of Malchus is distinct from all the attributes in its source,
in its essence and in the manner
(in the existence)
of its essence,
in its arousal and in the manner of its arousal,
in its revelation and in the manner of its revelation.
The distinction in its source is,
that all the attributes and Sefiros are included in Arich Anpin, and the attribute of Malchus is rooted in Reisha d’Lo Isyada92.
The distinction in its essence and in the existence
(manner)
of its essence is,
that all the attributes and Sefiros,
even as they are in their source in the aspect of Arich,
are the nine lights29,
and the attribute of Malchus is only a point and in the aspect of non-existence.
The distinction in its arousal and in the manner of its arousal and in its revelation is,
that all the attributes and Sefiros are aroused also by themselves,
and therefore the manner of their arousal is also from something that is not of their level, and likewise their revelation is also upon that which is not of their level at all,
but not so the attribute of Malchus, its arousal is only through another,
and therefore the manner of its arousal is only from one who is of its level,
and also the revelation of Malchus is only upon one who is of its level.
And the distinction in the manner of its revelation is,
that all the attributes, their influence
(and revelation)
is in closeness
[and like the influence of the attribute of Chesed,
which is from the feeling of closeness of the influencer to the recipient,
and so it is with the influence of all the attributes,
and even with the influence of the attribute of Gevurah,
which is from the feeling of connection and closeness],
but not so the attribute of Malchus, its influence
(and revelation)
is in distance and separation,
loftiness and exaltation.
And behold, the cause for all these distinctions between the attribute of Malchus and the other attributes is the distinction between them in their source.
For because93
the source of Malchus is in Reisha d’Lo Isyada,
the aspect of Reisha d’Lo Isyada is not only "the head that is not known" but also "the head that does not know"94,
that it is not in a known essence even to itself,
therefore,
even as it comes into an aspect of drawing down
(its essence and the existence of its essence)
it is in the aspect of non-existence95,
and in order for it to come into an aspect of arousal,
it is specifically through another.
And therefore also in the manner of its arousal and in its revelation, it requires a related other,
specifically one of its level.
And this is,
that all the attributes,
since the essence of the attribute and also its arousal is from the person himself,
and like the attribute of Chesed and Rachamim that are relevant
(also their arousal)
even without another,
therefore it does not matter what the thing is that he is being kind to and having mercy upon,
and they are relevant even to animals96
even though they are not of the level of man.
But not so the attribute of Malchus,
since it comes specifically from another,
therefore it is necessary that the other
(the one who arouses the attribute of Malchus,
and upon whom the attribute of Malchus is revealed)
be specifically of his level,
for kingship applies only to the species of man and not to animals,
and also it is necessary that the other be specifically separate,
"there is no king without a nation"97,
but not so regarding children, the matter of kingship does not apply.
And this matter also relates to the manner of the revelation of Malchus,
this that the influence of Malchus is specifically in the aspect of distance98.
And also this matter
(this that the influence of Malchus is in the aspect of distance and separation,
loftiness and exaltation)
relates to this that the source of Malchus is in Reisha d’Lo Isyada,
because the matter of exaltation over a nation comes from the aspect of essential exaltation.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the relationship of "nation" (Am) between Israel and God is superior to that of "children" (Banim), as it enables God's kingship and is rooted in His essential loftiness, which is the focus of Rosh Hashanah.
section.t: And this is)
And based on the above
(that the matter of kingship is specifically over a nation,
but not so over children)
it will be understood,
that this that Israel are His nation, blessed be He, has in it an advantage over "you are children,"
because specifically through this
(that they are His nation)
the Holy One, blessed be He, is King of Israel.
And although this that He is King of Israel is that He is exalted and elevated above them
(seemingly distance and separation),
behold, the exaltation over a nation is connected
(as above)
with this that He is essentially exalted and elevated.
And this is what is stated99
"Va’anachnu Amecha v’Tzon Mar’itecha" (And we are Your nation and the flock of Your pasture),
and it is brought in the Midrash on the verse100
"Dodi Li va’Ani Lo HaRo’eh BaShoshanim" (My beloved is mine and I am His, who pastures among the roses),
"He is to me as a father and I am to Him as a son; He is to me as a shepherd and I am to Him as a flock,"
that from this that at first it says "He is to me as a father and I am to Him as a son" and afterwards it adds "He is to me as a shepherd and I am to Him as a flock,"
it is understood,
that the matter of "He is to me as a shepherd etc." is higher than the matter of "He is to me as a father etc.,"
and as is known101
that the matter of "He is to me as a shepherd and I am to Him as a flock" is in the aspect of "Gam" (also)102
"Ben v’Ach Ein Lo" (a son and a brother he has none).
And from this it is also understood regarding the title "Amecha" (Your nation)
(which is in sequence with "v’Tzon Mar’itecha")
that it is more elevated than this that Israel are His children, blessed be He.
For since there is no king without a nation,
behold, it is found,
that this that the Holy One, blessed be He, is King of Israel103
is specifically from the aspect of this that Israel are His nation, blessed be He.
Because the matter of loftiness and exaltation is
(as above)
from the aspect of this that He is essentially exalted and elevated.
And this is that the main emphasis on Rosh Hashanah
(and in the prayers of Rosh Hashanah)
is on the matter of kingship,
because the renewal of Rosh Hashanah
(over the 25th of Elul),
"Zeh HaYom" (this day),
is
(as above)
that Yisrael
[whose source is from the aspect of "Tzur" (Rock),
a concealment that is not in existence]
draw down the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof,
and the source of Malchus is in Reisha d’Lo Isyada
(the aspect of concealment that is not in existence),
and higher still, in the aspect of the loftiness of the Essence.
